integrity: The proof is analytic for all stated parameters. Finite partition checks in the accompanying verifier are corroborative only and are not used as evidence for the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the binary first-column threshold on permutation-invariant inputs, not full weak or unitary Schur sampling.
It changes the elementary pairwise-SWAP implementation cost of the Schur decision stage; it does not improve rank-testing copy complexity.
The total-variation guarantee is for the binary classical output, not for a full post-measurement Schur instrument.
Constants and logarithmic factors are not claimed optimal.
title: Dimension-free pairwise-SWAP implementation of the Schur rank-threshold test
